source: NCERT Class VIII, Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Polity Ch. 1.

sections.heading: 1. Universal Adult Franchise
points: **Universal Adult Franchise** = the right of **every adult citizen** to vote, regardless of caste, religion, gender, wealth or education.
In India, the voting age is **18 years** (lowered from 21 by the **61st Constitutional Amendment, 1988**).
It rests on the principle of **political equality** — 'one person, one vote, one value'.

sections.heading: 2. Elections in India
points: Elections let people **choose their representatives** and hold them accountable.
India holds **regular, free and fair** elections (Lok Sabha and State Assemblies every 5 years).
Voting is by **secret ballot** (now **Electronic Voting Machines, EVMs**, with **VVPAT**).
**General elections** choose the Lok Sabha; **by-elections** fill vacant seats.

sections.heading: 3. The Election Commission
points: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is an **independent** constitutional body that **conducts elections** to Parliament, State legislatures and the offices of President and Vice-President.
It prepares **electoral rolls (voter lists)**, sets the **schedule**, enforces the **Model Code of Conduct**, and ensures fairness.
Its independence is key to free and fair elections.

sections.heading: 4. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Universal Adult Franchise = every adult can vote; voting age = 18 (61st Amendment, 1988).
Principle: political equality — one person, one vote, one value.
Elections: regular, free, fair; secret ballot via EVMs + VVPAT.
Election Commission of India = independent constitutional body conducting elections.
ECI prepares voter rolls, sets schedule, enforces the Model Code of Conduct.

sections.heading: 5. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: Voting age in India is **18**, lowered from 21 by the **61st Amendment (1988)**.
**Universal adult franchise** = every adult votes, regardless of wealth/education.
The **Election Commission** is an **independent constitutional body**.
Elections use **EVMs with VVPAT** and a **secret ballot**.
